messages:
Lina: Heads-up — need capacity plan for Q3 spikes (Black Friday style) and long lead times on H200. Vendors quoted 14–20 week lead for H200. Can we sketch GPU-hours + reservations by region?

Jorge: +1. I ran projections on current throughput. Baseline traffic ~120k reqs/day -> ~3.4M tokens/day -> ~400 GPU-hours/week on H100-like perf. With 3x growth in peak we need ~1,200 GPU-hours/week. I pushed a quick table to the infra drive.

Samir: Quick notes: H200 perf ≈ 1.6x H100 for our transformer stacks. H200 list price ~2.2x H100 in vendor quotes. Tradeoffs: reserve H200 for low-latency, high-throughput routes; use L40S for embeddings/batch jobs. Cost calc example: (1,200 h * $3.50/h) = $4,200/week — adjust after discounts. I'll draft a sensitivity model.

Mila: Region constraints to flag: EU cloud partner shows limited H200 allocation windows; if we reserve only in us-west we'll need cross-region routing and handle data residency. Also networking: during last peak we saw 30–40% link saturation on aggregation layers; need to validate 40Gbps uplink configs.

Jorge: Proposal sketch: reserved pool = 40 H200-equivalent GPUs for dedicated customers, 20 L40S for embeddings/low-cost batch, keep 60 H100 as fallbacks. Order timeline: place reservation this week (vendor lead ~16 weeks). Will add throughput mapping per pool.

deploy-bot: reservation request created — ID rsv-20240326-17. Vendors: vendorA (H200), vendorB (L40S). Estimated delivery window: 2024-07-15 -> 2024-08-05 (pending final PO).

Lina: Action items: Samir update cost model by EOD, Jorge draft reservation PR and capacity placard, Mila run 40Gbps perf test on staging by Friday. If vendors push lead >18w, fallback to staggered H100 purchases and temporary burst on cloud.

Samir: Cost model v1 uploaded. Quick numbers: H200 reserved effective cost $2.80/hr (after commit), H100 $1.60/hr, L40S $0.90/hr. Estimate Q3 incremental reserved burn +$120k/month for committed tier at projected utilization. Will add utilization sensitivity (50% / 70% / 90%).

Mila: Ran perf test on staging with 40Gbps uplinks — throughput +25%, but p99 jitter still spikes; kernel tunables + NIC firmware update lowered jitter. Logs: /infra/network/tests/40g-run-03.log. Need one more run with larger batch sizes.

Jorge: Also worth considering vendor financing / 6–12 month commit discounts. If we lock 12 months we can get ~15% lower effective cost vs month-to-month.

Lina: OK. Meeting tomorrow 10:00am to finalize numbers and submit PO. @Samir @Jorge @Mila please bring a one-slide summary (capacity, cost delta, regions). :thumbsup:
